warn_text: Do NOT plug USB or flash while BMCU is connected to the printer. Always connect/disconnect BMCU only when the printer is powered OFF. Printer firmware update is safest with BMCU disconnected.
help_usb_s3:
- Select firmware: Browse = from disk, Online = download latest from internet
- Click Flash
help_ttl_s1:
- Wire USB-Serial to BMCU
- Enter bootloader
help_ttl_s2:
- Select USB-Serial type (sets Baud/Fast baud presets)
- Select port
- (VID/PID is only for port filtering)
help_ttl_s3:
- Select firmware: Browse = from disk, Online = download latest from internet
- Click Flash
help_boot_steps:
Initial bootloader entry:
- Disconnect USB from the adapter/BMCU
- Hold BOOT
- While holding BOOT, connect the USB cable
- Release BOOT only when the LED on the BMCU main board lights up

If the flasher later asks you to re-enter the bootloader:
- Keep USB connected
- Hold BOOT
- Tap RESET
- Release BOOT
online_force_std_desc: Recommended default. Normal load pressure for most users.
online_force_soft_desc: Weaker load pressure during loading. If you hear grinding during loading, your BMG lever spring is probably too weak and you can use this firmware. Keep in mind this version may reject filament more often, so STANDARD is recommended by default.
online_force_hf_desc: Stronger load and print pressure. Use only if you really need more force.
online_retract_hint:
9.5cm is available for AMS_AUTO and AMS_A-D.
For long PTFE paths (P1S/P2S/etc.) usually choose 60-90cm.
online_opts_hint:
Autoload: automatic loading for DM (2 switches). For 1-switch boards: autoload via quick buffer tap.
RGB LED: channel LED matches configured filament color. Disable if you do not want lights.
ttl_hint_boot_reset: HOLD BOOT -> CONNECT USB -> RELEASE WHEN BMCU LED LIGHTS
android_no_device: No CH340 device found. Plug BMCU via USB OTG.
android_probe_fail: No serial driver for this USB device
android_device_hint_ttl: Use a USB-Serial adapter via USB OTG. Filter by selected adapter or use ALL.
android_no_device_usb: No CH340 device found. Plug BMCU via USB OTG.
android_no_device_ttl: No compatible USB-Serial adapter found. Plug adapter via USB OTG or change adapter filter.
nusb_status_none: No WCH ISP device. Disconnect 24V, connect the native USB cable only, then click Refresh.
flash_done_nusb: Flash complete. Disconnect USB, reconnect 24V power and start the BMCU normally.
help_nusb_s1:
- For Toaiot BMCU with built-in USB and no CH340
- Disconnect 24V power and connect the native USB cable only
help_nusb_s2:
- The CH32V203 should appear as a WCH ISP device
- No serial port selection is required
online_klipper_desc: BMCU-Klipper uses one firmware build. The latest firmware.bin will be downloaded automatically.
android_klipper_desc: BMCU-Klipper uses one firmware build. The latest firmware.bin will be downloaded automatically.
android_device_hint_native_usb: Toaiot Native USB: disconnect 24V and connect the built-in USB port. WCH ISP 4348:55E0 / 1A86:55E0.
android_no_device_native_usb: No WCH ISP device found. Disconnect 24V and connect the Toaiot native USB port.
android_native_safety: Native USB mode: disconnect 24V power first. Connect only the built-in USB cable while flashing. After flashing, disconnect USB and reconnect 24V.
